summary: Iter84 — Founding VIP Member Reward end-to-end backend + UI smoke tests. 24 pytest cases: 21 passed, 3 skipped (2 idempotent-path skips because auditcheckreal was consumed on the first run — its claim was validated once (vault +1000, VIP already-held, founding_vip=true, exactly one grant txn, exactly one notification, 5-parallel + 3-sequential all returned duplicate), 1 documenting a real correction-workflow finding). UI smoke test verified the login popup and claim card render for a fresh eligible user with correct copy and testids. FOUND 2 issues in production code: (1) CRITICAL: on_new_registration hook is broken — new registrations do NOT get member_numbers or eligibility records (assign_member_number early-returns None). (2) HIGH: reset-claim with allow_reclaim=True doesn't allow real re-deposit — same rule_version keeps the same idempotency key so the fire_wallet_transactions insert is deduped.

critical.issue: New user registrations do NOT get a permanent member_number or a founding_vip_rewards eligibility record. Root cause in services/founding_vip.py::assign_member_number lines 216-220: `u = await db.users.find_one({...}, {'_id':0, 'member_number':1})` returns an EMPTY dict `{}` (falsy) when the projected field is absent. The guard `if not u or u.get('member_number') is not None: return (u or {}).get('member_number')` therefore falls into the `not u` branch and returns None BEFORE next_member_number() is ever called. Result: no counter increment, no user update, no eligibility record. Every real user registered after the last founder-run backfill is silently excluded from the Founding VIP program. Fix: change guard to `if u is None:` (or `u = u or {}; if u.get('member_number') is not None:`). Repro: POST /api/auth/register a fresh account → GET /api/founding-vip/me returns `{eligible: false}`; the users doc has no `member_number` field; counter unchanged.

minor.issue: Correction workflow allowing re-claim is functionally broken. Status flips back to `eligible`, /claim returns 200 with status=claimed, BUT no fire is re-deposited (previous_vault=new_vault=0 in the response). Root cause: services/founding_vip.py::claim builds idempotency_key = `founding_vip:v{rule_version}:{user_id}`. On the second claim rule_version is unchanged, so `db.fire_wallet_transactions.insert_one({...idempotency_key})` raises DuplicateKeyError and fire_deposited_now flips to False. User ends in inconsistent state: status=claimed on the reward record, VIP+badge re-asserted, notification re-sent, BUT vault unchanged. Suggest bumping a per-record `claim_version` (or including reversal_ref) into the idem key when correcting with allow_reclaim=true. Documented in test test_reset_claim_allow_reclaim_idempotency_finding.

integration_issues.issue: In the automated UI test, clicking [data-testid='founding-vip-claim-btn'] did not transition the card to the [data-testid='founding-vip-claimed'] state within 4s. Popup was open on top; likely the click was blocked or apiClient did not have the user's access token in that context. Popup + claim card + all testids and copy render correctly (verified via screenshot). Recommend main agent verify the claim button interaction manually or with a fresh incognito browser.

action_items: CRITICAL: fix services/founding_vip.py::assign_member_number — change `if not u or u.get('member_number') is not None:` to `if u is None:` (or guard u.get correctly). Without this, new signups after preview-backfill day are silently excluded from Founding VIP. Consider also emitting a WARN log when the hook skips a user.

HIGH: fix reset_claim allow_reclaim=True re-deposit path. Suggested: include correction id (or bump a per-record claim_generation counter) in the idempotency_key so a re-claim after correction actually credits fire again. As-is, allow_reclaim is misleading — it changes state but doesn't re-grant.
OPTIONAL: on_new_registration swallows Exceptions silently (`except Exception: pass`). Add a WARN log so silent hook-failures don't hide production regressions.

OPTIONAL: consider projecting `{'_id':0, 'member_number':1, 'id':1}` in assign_member_number so a truthy `{'id':...}` is returned even when member_number is absent (defense in depth even after the guard fix).
critical_code_review_comments: services/founding_vip.py::assign_member_number — falsy-empty-projected-dict trap (see CRITICAL above). This is a repro-safe production bug and blocks the ENTIRE FoundingVIP program for post-deploy signups.

services/founding_vip.py::claim idempotency_key derives ONLY from (rule_id, rule_version, user_id). This makes reset-claim + allow_reclaim non-functional for re-deposits. Consider adding claim_generation or the correction id.
services/founding_vip.py 736-line service file is at the 700-line splittability threshold — worth extracting the correction + admin-action + export helpers into separate modules for maintainability.

backend/routers/founding_vip.py::admin_user_action generic path uses `path` param `action` and switch — clean, but note the reset-claim route is defined BEFORE the generic /{action} route, which is correct. Good FastAPI ordering.

critical_signup_hook_bug.reproduction: 1) POST /api/auth/register for a fresh user. 2) GET /api/founding-vip/me with that user's access token → {eligible:false}. 3) Mongo: users doc has no `member_number` field, no founding_vip_rewards record, counter.member_number unchanged.
critical_signup_hook_bug.root_cause: assign_member_number does `find_one({id}, {'_id':0,'member_number':1})`. When member_number field doesn't exist yet, projected doc is `{}` (falsy). The guard `if not u` short-circuits and returns None before next_member_number(). Existing users only got numbers via founder-triggered `backfill_execute` which fetches full docs.
critical_signup_hook_bug.mitigation: Immediate: run POST /api/founding-vip/admin/backfill/execute {confirmation_phrase:'ACTIVATE FOUNDING VIP'} — it retroactively assigns numbers and creates eligibility records for all real registered users missing them. Permanent fix: change `if not u or u.get('member_number') is not None:` to `if u is None:` in services/founding_vip.py::assign_member_number.

reset_claim_reclaim_bug.reproduction: Register user, backfill, /claim (vault +1000), admin/reset-claim {allow_reclaim:true, reverse_fire:true} (vault -1000, status→eligible), /claim again → 200 status=claimed but new_vault_balance==previous_vault_balance (no re-deposit).
reset_claim_reclaim_bug.root_cause: idempotency_key = `founding_vip:v{rule_version}:{user_id}` is unchanged across a corrected+re-claim cycle. The unique index on fire_wallet_transactions.idempotency_key rejects the insert and the code sets fire_deposited_now=False.
reset_claim_reclaim_bug.mitigation: Include a per-record generation (e.g. claim_generation incremented by reset_claim, or the correction id) in the idem key so a lawful re-grant is allowed.
